commands.name: search-datasets
commands.summary: Search the NYC Open Data catalog by keyword, tag, category or asset type, with sorting and offset paging

commands.name: suggest-dataset-titles
commands.summary: Autocomplete dataset titles that match a partial keyword

commands.name: list-catalog-facets
commands.summary: List the catalog's browse facets: domain categories and custom facets such as Data Collection, with their options

commands.name: get-dataset
commands.summary: Get full metadata for a dataset by its 4x4 id: name, description, agency, category, view and download counts, update times and column definitions

commands.name: query-dataset
commands.summary: Run a SoQL query against a dataset's rows: select, filter, aggregate, count, or page with LIMIT/OFFSET

commands.name: export-dataset-csv
commands.summary: Download the entire dataset as CSV text (this can be very large for big datasets)

commands.name: list-dataset-changes
commands.summary: List a dataset's update/version history (archive entries with version number and timestamp), using cursor paging

commands.name: list-dataset-attachments
commands.summary: List the file ids of a dataset's attachments (data dictionaries, user guides) with their scan state

dropped.name: download-attachment
dropped.reason: Attachments are binary Office/ZIP files (the output starts with PK). Decoding them as text produces garbled bytes that an agent cannot use, and the command has no recorded source.
